##### Project general facts

FH Residency is a contemporary residential development designed for modern urban living, combining clean architectural lines with practical functionality. The building presents a refined, minimalist façade and well-organized layouts that prioritize comfort, efficiency, and natural light. Offering a variety of apartment types, each residence is thoughtfully planned to create a seamless balance between style and everyday usability, making it an ideal choice for dynamic city lifestyles.

The development is complemented by a comprehensive range of amenities that enhance both convenience and community living. Residents can enjoy a fully equipped fitness center, swimming pool, and dedicated co-working spaces, catering to both active routines and professional needs. A welcoming lobby with reception, separate service waiting area, and an on-site coffee shop add to the ease of daily living, while additional shared facilities create a comfortable and well-connected residential environment.

Interiors are finished to a high modern standard, featuring stylish materials and efficient layouts that reflect a contemporary aesthetic. Kitchens are equipped with built-in appliances, ensuring functionality and convenience. Residences are delivered semi-furnished, offering a ready-to-live-in solution while still allowing flexibility to personalize the space according to individual preferences.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Triangle, often referred to as JVT, is a well-planned and family-friendly residential community located in the heart of Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Developed by Nakheel Properties, it is characterized by its unique triangular shape and thoughtful design, creating a tranquil and vibrant environment for residents.

One of the defining features of Jumeirah Village Triangle is its extensive landscaping and lush green spaces. The community is adorned with parks, jogging and cycling tracks, and serene walking paths, making it an ideal place for outdoor activities and leisurely strolls. The abundance of greenery and open spaces adds to the serene ambiance, offering a peaceful retreat from the bustling city.

JVT places a strong emphasis on community living and family-friendly amenities. It boasts a range of retail outlets, supermarkets, and dining options, ensuring residents have easy access to daily necessities. Additionally, Jumeirah Village Triangle has its own international school, making it a convenient choice for families with school-age children.
